newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco bought 35,000 T soft wheat for October.
newsitem.headline: Morocco bought 35,000 T soft wheat for October.

text.p: Morocco bought 35,000 tonnes soft wheat on Wednesday at between $186.75 and $189.5 per tonne C&F for delivery in the first half of October, an official at the Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales et Legumineuses (ONICL) said.
A first lot of 20,000 tonnes was purchased at $186.75 per tonne C&F for 1-10 October 1996. It will be delivered at the southern port of Agadir.
The second lot of 15,000 tonnes was acquired at $189.5 per tonne C&F for delivery 10-15 October at the northern ports of Tangier and Nador.
These quantities are U.S. and French optional wheat, he said.
Officials announced earlier that Morocco expects to import up to 1.0 million tonnes of cereals, including soft wheat, during the season 1996/97.
